Чёткий текст, выбор разрешения и боковая: Crisp text, resolution settings and a contextual side panel. Current mod features are designed primarily for this interface.
Включает поддержку оверлея и скриншотов: Enables Steam overlay and screenshot integration. Shares the graphics backend with the HD interface.
Группирует техники, предметы, магию и ор: Groups techniques, items, magic and weapons for selection with letters and numbers. Works on its own or alongside Advanced Legacy.
Добавляет назначения действий через соче: Assigns actions to Shift/Ctrl and number combinations. Can be used on its own or alongside V/B/M/N groups.
Позволяет отмечать нужные навыки и предм: Mark skills and items as favorites for quick access in battle lists. Supports native controls, combat groups and Advanced Legacy.
Показывает подготовленные и выполняемые: Displays prepared and executing actor actions. Helps track command order and remaining actions.
Сохранённые последовательности до шести: Save sequences of up to six steps and trigger them manually. Supports skills, items and weapons; requires V/B/M/N groups, but not equipment loadouts.
Поддерживающие предметы, очищения и Gun: Maintains selected item effects, cleanses and Gun Break when appropriate. Each battle starts with no active rules; enable individual actions during battle.
Ускорение боя по Ctrl: Hold Ctrl to speed up battle
При удержании Ctrl сокращает анимации, п: Hold Ctrl to shorten battle animations, pauses and transitions. Commands and targets are still selected manually.
Подробные карточки F7, просмотр участник: Detailed F7 cards, H participant/effect inspection and action forecasts. When an outcome cannot be reliably calculated, its forecasting limitation is shown.
Записывает произошедшие действия и резул: Records observed actions and results for the battle journal and summary. Enemy attacks appear as they are observed.
Сохраняет именованные наборы экипировки: Save named equipment sets and apply them manually. Missing items and equipment-change restrictions are respected.
Позволяет улучшать надетое оружие без пр: Upgrade currently equipped weapons without removing them first. The game determines upgrade costs and conditions.
Удаляет младшие варианты снаряжения при: Removes lower equipment variants when corresponding upgrades are owned. Changes inventory; disabling it does not restore items already removed.
При удержании Alt отмечает доступные пол: Hold Alt to highlight available useful interactions on the current map. Helps find objects that still have something to offer.
Собирает доступные вне боя навыки в отде: Provides a separate menu for skills available outside battle. Supported stealth can be renewed automatically at its normal MP cost.
Позволяет использовать подходящие души с: Consume eligible souls in a chosen quantity. Key and story items are excluded.
Добавляет 100 слотов, сортировку, подпис: Adds 100 slots, sorting, labels and quick-save access. Save lists show additional progression information.
Переназначение клавиш, громкость, настро: Key remapping, volume controls, running options and learned-book markers. Individual settings are available in the game.
Сохраняет локальные журналы ошибок и све: Keeps local error logs and performance information. Reports are not sent automatically.
